texts.zh: 我们的预防措施和特种设备仍不充分。我们在[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]建立殖民地之后很快就跟地面的团队失去了联络。从落脚点收到的最后一条通讯显示，天空被微小的淹没了前哨的黑色物体遮蔽。
texts.en: Our precautions and special equipment were not enough. Shortly after establishing a colony on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], we lost contact with our teams on the ground. The last communication we received from the settlement showed a sky darkened by small black bodies swarming the outpost.
